title: Tenants: Edit, Disable, Reload and Remove | Orchard Core
description:
Once an Orchard Core application hosts several tenants, each one needs looking after: its settings change, a site has to be switched off for a while, and a tenant that is no longer needed has to go.

The Tenants list of the Default tenant offers these actions in the row of a tenant: Edit, Disable, Enable, Reload and Remove. This video shows what each one does, which states of a tenant allow it, and how to change several tenants at once.

In this video:
• The Tenants list: search, filter and the actions of a row
• The states of a tenant: Uninitialized, Running, Disabled and Initializing
• Edit a tenant: category, description, Url Prefix and Hostname
• Disable and enable a tenant
• Reload a tenant
• Disable several tenants at once
• Remove a tenant
